# The Seattle Times
> Local news, sports, business, politics, entertainment, travel, restaurants and opinion for Seattle and the Pacific Northwest.

The Seattle Times is a regional news organization covering Seattle, Washington state, and the Pacific Northwest with reporting across local government, public safety, transportation, climate, education, business, sports, culture, and opinion.

## Local News
- [Seattle News](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/): Main local news hub for Seattle, King County, and regional reporting.
- [Law & Justice](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/law-justice/): Coverage of courts, crime, policing, prosecutions, and legal issues.
- [Local Politics](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/politics/): Reporting on Seattle, King County, and Washington political developments.
- [Eastside](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/eastside/): News from Bellevue, Redmond, Kirkland, and Eastside communities.
- [Health](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/health/): Public health, hospitals, medical research, and community health coverage.
- [Mental Health](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/mental-health/): Reporting focused on mental health systems, policy, and lived experiences.
- [Project Homeless](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/homeless/): Ongoing coverage of homelessness, housing instability, and policy responses.

## Public Interest Reporting
- [Times Watchdog](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/times-watchdog/): Investigations, accountability reporting, and public-interest journalism from the newsroom.
- [Traffic Lab](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/transportation/): Transportation reporting on transit, roads, traffic, ferries, and mobility.
- [Climate Lab](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/climate-lab/): Climate reporting on emissions, resilience, policy, and regional impacts.
- [Environment](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/environment/): Coverage of conservation, land use, pollution, and natural resources.
- [Data/FYI Guy](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/data/): Data-driven stories, explainers, and analysis of regional trends.
- [Equity & Inclusion](https://www.seattletimes.com/tag/equity-and-inclusion/): Stories tagged around race, equity, inclusion, and social justice topics.

## Education
- [Education Lab](https://www.seattletimes.com/education-lab/): Solutions-oriented education reporting on schools, students, and learning outcomes.
- [Education](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/education/): General education news from Seattle, districts, and higher education.
- [Local News](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/): Broader metro reporting often intersecting with schools and youth issues.

## Weather & Climate
- [Weather](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/weather/): Seattle-area weather coverage, forecasts, storms, and seasonal conditions.
- [Climate Lab](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/climate-lab/): In-depth climate journalism focused on the Pacific Northwest.
- [Environment](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/environment/): Environmental reporting on ecosystems, regulation, and regional change.
- [Traffic Lab](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/transportation/): Transportation coverage relevant to weather disruptions and infrastructure impacts.

## Business & Technology
- [Business](https://www.seattletimes.com/business/): Main business news hub covering companies, economy, and labor.
- [Business & Tech](https://www.seattletimes.com/business/): Seattle-area business and technology reporting, including major employers.
- [Amazon](https://www.seattletimes.com/business/amazon/): Coverage of Amazon’s business, workforce, and regional influence.
- [Microsoft](https://www.seattletimes.com/business/microsoft/): Reporting on Microsoft, products, leadership, and local impact.
- [Real Estate](https://www.seattletimes.com/business/real-estate/): Housing market, development, commercial property, and affordability news.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/): Main sports hub with Seattle and national sports coverage.
- [Seahawks](https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/seahawks/): News, analysis, and game coverage for the Seattle Seahawks.
- [Mariners](https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/mariners/): Reporting on the Seattle Mariners, roster moves, and games.
- [Kraken](https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/kraken/): Coverage of Seattle Kraken hockey, results, and analysis.
- [Sounders](https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/sounders/): News and match coverage for Seattle Sounders FC.
- [Storm](https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/storm/): Reporting on the Seattle Storm and women’s basketball.
- [UW Huskies](https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/uw-husky-football/): Coverage of University of Washington football and college athletics.

## Arts, Food & Lifestyle
- [Entertainment](https://www.seattletimes.com/entertainment/): Arts, culture, television, music, and entertainment coverage.
- [Food & Drink](https://www.seattletimes.com/life/food-drink/): Restaurant news, dining coverage, recipes, and food culture.
- [Travel](https://www.seattletimes.com/life/travel/): Travel reporting, destination ideas, and Pacific Northwest trip guidance.
- [Pacific NW Magazine](https://www.seattletimes.com/pacific-nw-magazine/): Features and lifestyle stories from the Sunday magazine.
- [Life](https://www.seattletimes.com/life/): Lifestyle coverage including wellness, home, and community interests.

## Opinion
- [Opinion](https://www.seattletimes.com/opinion/): Editorials, columns, endorsements, and reader-focused commentary.
- [Editorials](https://www.seattletimes.com/opinion/editorials/): Institutional editorials on public policy and regional issues.
- [Letters to the Editor](https://www.seattletimes.com/opinion/letters-to-the-editor/): Reader responses and community viewpoints on current events.
- [Danny Westneat](https://www.seattletimes.com/author/danny-westneat/): Column archive for Seattle Times opinion writer Danny Westneat.
- [Naomi Ishisaka](https://www.seattletimes.com/author/naomi-ishisaka/): Author page for Naomi Ishisaka’s reporting and commentary.

## Authors & Topics
- [Danny Westneat](https://www.seattletimes.com/author/danny-westneat/): Author archive for columns and commentary on regional issues.
- [Naomi Ishisaka](https://www.seattletimes.com/author/naomi-ishisaka/): Author archive covering equity, community, and civic topics.
- [Equity & Inclusion](https://www.seattletimes.com/tag/equity-and-inclusion/): Topic page aggregating stories related to equity and inclusion.
- [Data/FYI Guy](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/data/): Data reporting archive useful for statistics and explanatory journalism.
